tagline: BelOMO取景器相机，1973 年发布
description: BelOMO于1973年推出的取景器相机。配备Triplet 69-3, 40 mm f/4。快门速度1/30 s – 1/250 s, B。使用135。0.8 m。

specs.英文简介: Vilia (Вилия in RussianVilia is a river flowing through Belorussia and Lithuania) compact camera was produced by the Soviet company BelOMO of Minsk in Soviet Belorussia from 1973 to 1986; some 2 to 3 millions were made.
